空城计

刘芬 文
耿建平 张强 彭一 图
高彤 审校

化学工业出版社
北京

[P3] 三国时期，蜀国的丞相诸葛亮为实现先帝刘备的遗愿，兴复汉室，出兵攻打魏国。

[P4] 他派马谡去驻守军事要地
街亭，并让王平一同前去相助，
嘱咐道：“街亭虽小，但没有险
阻，易攻难守，你们千万小
心。”诸葛亮则亲率大军，从斜
谷出发，直取郿城。

[P5] 马谡自认为熟读兵书，不听王平的建议，固执地在山顶扎寨，最终被魏军四面包围，断了水源。他虽杀出重围，侥幸逃命，但街亭失守了。魏军连夺三座城后，便向蜀军的屯粮之地西城杀去。

[P6] 诸葛亮正在营帐内等待战报。前方的探子飞马来报：“丞相，马谡在山顶扎寨，街亭失守！”，

[P7] 诸葛亮懊恼地说道：“好一个胆大的马谡呀。临行前我是怎么交代你的？失了街亭，我军进不能攻，退不能守呀！”

[P8] 诸葛亮料想街亭一失，司马懿的军队很快就会打过来，于是
命令大军悄悄退兵，自己则带五千人马前往西城搬运粮草。

[P9] 到了西城，诸葛亮刚分出一半人马，运出一批粮草，忽然探子又来汇报：“司马懿十五万大军杀来，离西城不到四十里了！”

[P10] 众军士大惊失色：“魏军行动好快呀！这该如何是好？城里只剩两千余人，难道只能束手就擒了？”

[P11] 诸葛亮沉思了一会儿，摇着羽毛扇说道：“众军士莫慌，山人自有妙计！传西城老兵来见！”
“丞相唤小人们进帐，有何吩咐？”两名老兵入帐拜见丞相。
诸葛亮沉稳地说道：“你们率一队兵士，穿普通百姓衣服，将城门大开，在门前打扫街道；收起城上的旗帜，任何人不得高声说话。”
诸葛亮又对两名童子说道：“你二人带瑶琴美酒，随山人去城楼。”

[P12] 大军压城，丞相不调兵
遣将，却要将城门大开，这是为什么？众军士一头雾水，不过看到诸葛亮一副胸有成竹的样子，只好按照他的吩咐迅速准备。

[P13] 城外烟尘滚滚，司马懿大军分两路杀到城下。司马懿远远望着西城，只见城门大开，城上不见一旗一帜，一兵一卒，城内的百姓在悠闲地打扫街道，很是疑惑。

[P14] 此时城楼上突然传来袅袅琴音，琴声清雅祥和，有人高声和乐吟唱：“我正在城楼观山景，耳听得城外乱纷纷。旌旗招展空翻影，却原来是司马发来的兵……亦非是马谡无谋少学问，皆因是将帅不和失街亭。司马懿，你连得三城多侥幸，请上城来听我抚琴。”
司马懿凝神细看，城楼上端坐一人，披鹤氅、戴纶巾，笑容可掬，焚香弹琴，不是诸葛孔明，又是何人？

[P15] 司马懿的儿子司马昭说道：“看他城门大开，还不杀进去？”司马懿左思右想，心存疑惑，按兵不动。司马昭不屑地说道：“诸葛亮这是在装模作样，城内一定空虚！”
司马懿却摇了摇头，说道：“诸葛亮一生谨慎，从不冒险。你听他的琴声如此安闲，城内定有伏兵。万不可中他的奸计！
全军速后退四十里！”
城内的军士见魏军后撤，无不惊奇：“司马懿十五万精兵强将，为何见了丞相就退兵了呢？”

[P16] 诸葛亮抚掌大笑：“司马懿生性多疑，他怕城中另有埋伏，所以撤退。不过，他还会回来，我们要尽快退回汉中。”
众军士都叹服诸葛亮的谋略。

[P17] 司马懿在撤退途中遭遇了诸葛亮事先安排的伏兵，一路奔逃，回到街亭，暗自庆幸自己识破了诸葛亮的计策。

[P18] 忽然探子来报：“西城中的蜀军早已撤走了，没有什么埋伏，刚才山谷里也只有几千蜀兵，根本无法和我军对抗！”
司马懿气得直跺脚，他仰天长叹：“诸葛亮还是技高一筹啊！”
这正是：敌军万人何足惧，瑶琴三尺胜雄师！

[P19] 后来“空城计”成为三十六计之一，泛指掩饰自己力量空虚、迷惑对方的军事策略。《三十六计》对“空城计”的描述为：“虚者虚之，疑中生疑；刚柔之际，奇而复奇。”

[P2] "13th Five-Year Plan"

The Empty City Strategy

Liu Fen, Text
Geng Jianping, Zhang Qiang, Peng Yi, Illustrations
Gao Tong, Editor

Chemical Industry Press
Beijing

[P3] In the Three Kingdoms period, Zhuge Liang, the Chancellor of Shu, led troops to attack Wei in order to fulfill Emperor Liu Bei's last wish and restore the Han dynasty.

[P4] He sent Ma Su to guard the strategically important site of Jieting, and had Wang Ping accompany him, instructing: "Though Jieting is small, it has no natural defenses, making it easy to attack and hard to defend. You must be extremely careful." Zhuge Liang then personally led the main army, setting out from Xie Valley to directly attack Meicheng.

[P5] Ma Su, believing himself well-versed in military strategy, ignored Wang Ping's advice and stubbornly set up camp on the mountain top. He was eventually surrounded by Wei forces on all sides and cut off from water. Though he managed to break through the encirclement and escape narrowly, the strategic pass of Jieting was lost. After capturing three cities in succession, the Wei army advanced toward the vital supply base of Xicheng, the heartland of Shu forces.

[P6] Zhuge Liang was waiting for battle reports inside the camp. A scout galloped forward to report: "General, Ma Su has set up camp on the mountain top, and Jieting has fallen!"

[P7] Zhuge Liang said with frustration, "What a reckless Ma Su! How did I instruct you before you left? If we lose Jieting, our army will be unable to advance or retreat!"

[P8] Zhuge Liang realized that once Jieting was lost, Sima Yi's army would soon come. So he
ordered the main force to retreat quietly, and took 5,000 troops himself to Xicheng to transport supplies.

[P9] Upon arriving at Xicheng, Zhuge Liang had just divided half his troops and sent out a batch of grain and grass, when suddenly a scout came to report: "Simayi's army of 150,000 is advancing, less than forty li away from Xicheng!"

[P10] The soldiers were greatly alarmed: "The Wei army is moving so fast! What should we do? There are only over two thousand people left in the city. Could we only surrender without a fight?"

[P11] Zhuge Liang thought for a moment, fanning himself with his feather fan and said, "Soldiers, do not panic. I have a clever plan! Summon the veteran soldiers from Xicheng to see me!"
"General, you've summoned us to your tent. What instructions do you have?" Two veteran soldiers entered the tent and bowed to the general.
Zhuge Liang calmly said, "You shall lead a squad of soldiers, dressed as common civilians, open the city gates, and sweep the streets in front of the gate; lower the flags on the city walls, and no one is to speak loudly."
Zhuge Liang then said to two young attendants, "You two bring the zither and fine wine, and follow me to the city tower."

[P12] The enemy army is pressing hard on the city, yet the Chancellor does not mobilize troops or send out generals. Instead, he orders the city gates to be opened wide. Why is this? The soldiers are baffled, but seeing Zhuge Liang's calm and confident demeanor, they can only follow his orders and prepare quickly.

[P13] Outside the city, dust rolled as Sima Yi's army advanced in two columns to the city walls. Sima Yi looked far off at Xicheng and saw the city gates wide open, no flags or banners on the walls, not a single soldier in sight, while the civilians inside were leisurely sweeping the streets. He was deeply puzzled.

[P14] Suddenly, from the city tower came the soft sound of a zither, clear and elegant. Someone sang aloud in harmony: "I'm standing on the city tower, watching the mountain scenery, while hearing the chaos outside the city walls. The banners flutter in vain, and it turns out to be the troops sent by Sima. ... It's not that Ma Su lacked strategy or knowledge, but because the generals and commanders were not in harmony, leading to the loss of Jieting. Sima Yi, you've gained three cities by luck. Please come up to the tower and listen to me play the zither." 
Sima Yi looked closely. On the tower sat a man, wearing a crane-feather cloak and a silk cap, smiling gently, burning incense and playing the zither. Could it be anyone other than Zhuge Liang?

[P15] Simayi's son, Sima Zhao, said, "Look, the city gates are wide open—why not charge in?" Simayi thought carefully, feeling doubtful, and held his troops back. Sima Zhao sneered, "Zhuge Liang is just pretending. The city must be empty!"
Simayi shook his head and said, "Zhuge Liang is always cautious and never takes risks. Listen to his calm music—there must be an ambush inside. We must not fall for his trick!
Retreat forty li immediately!"
The soldiers inside the city, seeing the Wei army retreat, were amazed: "Why did Simayi, with his 150,000 elite troops and strong generals, retreat upon seeing the Chancellor?"

[P16] Zhuge Liang clapped his hands and laughed: "Simawei is naturally suspicious. He fears there might be an ambush in the city, so he retreated. However, he will return. We must quickly retreat back to Hanzhong." 
All the soldiers admired Zhuge Liang's strategy.

[P17] Simá Yì encountered the ambush troops arranged by Zhuge Liang during his retreat, fled in panic, returned to Jiating, and secretly rejoiced that he had uncovered Zhuge Liang's scheme.

[P18] Suddenly, a scout reported: "The Shu troops in Xicheng have already withdrawn. There's no ambush. Earlier in the valley, there were only a few thousand Shu soldiers, completely unable to resist our army!"
Simawei stomped his feet in anger, looking up to the sky and sighing: "Zhuge Liang is still one step ahead!"
This is exactly: A thousand enemy soldiers are no match; a three-foot zither defeats a mighty army!

[P19] Later, the 'Empty City Strategy' became one of the Thirty-Six Stratagems, broadly referring to a military tactic that conceals one's weakness and confuses the enemy. The 'Thirty-Six Stratagems' describes the 'Empty City Strategy' as: 'Make the empty appear empty, so doubt arises from doubt; at the juncture of hardness and softness, the extraordinary becomes extraordinary again.'
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《空城计》的封面，展示了以京剧脸谱风格绘制的诸葛亮、司马懿等角色，标题和作者信息清晰可见。
[P2] 本页为绘本《空城计》的封面，展示了以京剧脸谱风格绘制的诸葛亮、司马懿等角色，标题和作者信息清晰可见。
[P3] 本页描绘了三国时期蜀国丞相诸葛亮为实现先帝刘备遗愿、兴复汉室而出兵攻打魏国的背景，画面中诸葛亮手持羽扇，与两名武将对峙。
[P4] 诸葛亮派马谡和王平驻守街亭，并叮嘱其小心防守，自己则率主力从斜谷出发，直取郿城。
[P5] 本页讲述了马谡不听王平劝告，在山顶扎寨，最终被魏军包围、水源被断，虽突围逃生但街亭失守，魏军随后向蜀军的屯粮重地西城进发。
[P6] 诸葛亮在营帐中等待战报，探子飞马前来报告马谡在山顶扎寨导致街亭失守的消息。
[P7] 诸葛亮得知马谡失守街亭后，感到懊恼和焦虑，担忧蜀军陷入进退两难的境地。
[P8] 诸葛亮预见到街亭失守后司马懿大军将至，于是命令主力部队悄悄撤退，自己则带领五千人马前往西城搬运粮草。
[P9] 诸葛亮刚在西城分兵运粮，探子紧急报告司马懿十五万大军已逼近西城，距离不足四十里。
[P10] 诸葛亮在西城面对魏军逼近，众军士惊慌失措，担忧兵力不足，只能束手就擒。
[P11] 诸葛亮在西城面对魏军逼近，沉着应对，命令士兵扮作百姓大开城门打扫街道，收起旗帜，并让童子带琴酒上城楼，准备实施空城计。
[P12] 面对魏军逼近，诸葛亮命令士兵大开城门、打扫街道，众军士虽困惑不解，但见诸葛亮胸有成竹，只得遵命行事，为实施空城计做准备。
[P13] 司马懿率军逼近西城，发现城门大开、城上无兵无旗，城内百姓悠闲扫街，感到十分疑惑。
[P14] 司马懿率军逼近西城，听到城楼上传来诸葛亮弹琴吟唱，城内一片平静，他凝神细看，认出城楼上之人正是诸葛亮，内心疑虑重重。
[P15] 司马懿率军逼近西城，见城门大开、诸葛亮在城楼抚琴，疑有埋伏，遂下令全军后退四十里。城内军士对此感到惊奇，不解为何魏军见丞相便退兵。
[P16] 诸葛亮在城楼上笑谈司马懿因多疑而退兵，并预判其会卷土重来，众军士对其谋略深感佩服。
[P17] 司马懿在撤退途中遭遇伏兵，狼狈奔逃，回到街亭后暗自庆幸自己识破了诸葛亮的计策。
[P18] 司马懿在撤退途中得知西城并无埋伏，仅存少量蜀军，气愤之余感叹诸葛亮计谋高明。画面描绘了司马懿骑马听报，探子禀报军情的场景。
[P19] 本页解释了‘空城计’成为三十六计之一的含义，并引用《三十六计》中的原文描述其策略精髓，画面描绘了西城城门大开、士兵扫街的场景。
[P20] 画面描绘了三位骑马的武将，其中一位身着白色战袍、头戴红缨冠，疑似司马懿，正与两位部下策马前行，背景为素色纸面，无文字内容。
